tshe gzungs ni/'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal/ /mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skya

tei:div.tei:p: ))tshe gzungs ni/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ri mi ta a yur+dz+nyā na su bi nish+tsi tate dz+wa rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye/ ma hā puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bhā ro ba tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharmā te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wa re swā hā/ ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ ā mā ra ṇi dzī wan+te ye swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas mthar/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags// mi yi seṅge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs te// snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na// sbyin pa'i stobs kyis tshe yang 'phel bar shog /tshul khrims stobs kyi= mi yi seṅge= snying rje can gyi= tshul khrims stobs kyi= bzod pa'i stobs kyi= mi yi seṅge= snying rje can gyi= bzod pa'i stobs kyi= brtson 'grus stobs kyi= mi yi seṅga= snying rje can gyi= brtson 'grus stobs kyi= bsam gtan stobs kyi= mi yi seṅge= snying rje can gyi= bsam gtan stobs kyi= shes rab stobs kyi= mi yi seṅge= snying rje can gyi= shes rab stobs kyi= sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa ste// bkra shes des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces so/// /
